\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows}

\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{open map}{open map}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.5pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-.5\pgflinewidth}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{6\pgfutil@tempdima}
}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.5pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfsetbuttcap
  \pgfsetmiterjoin
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{-4\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{6\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{4\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfusepathqstroke
}
\pgfarrowsdeclarealias{inclusion}{inclusion}{open map}{open map}
\pgfarrowsdeclarereversed{projection}{projection}{open map}{open map}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\small}]
  \node (A) at (0,1.2) {$A$};
  \node (B) at (3,1.2) {$B$};
  \node (C) at (0,0) {$A/\!\sim$};
  \node (D) at (3,0) {$B/\!\sim$};
  \draw[blue,very thick,-{inclusion}] (A) to[bend left=18] node[above] {$i$} (B);
  \draw[red,very thick,-{projection}] (B) to[bend left=18] node[below] {$p$} (A);
  \draw[thick,{projection}-{inclusion}] (A) -- node[left] {$q_A$} (C);
  \draw[thick,-{inclusion}] (C) -- node[below] {$\bar i$} (D);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
